messages:
eva: kicking off a short thread: onboarding v6-quant-fuse into staggered canary. want to lock down a versioned gate that ties model lineage to auto-fallback rules.
hugo: good. we need deterministic policy: metric thresholds + provenance checks (model_lease + commit hash) before any auto action.
sasha: observed earlier regressions where a bad build id got promoted due to noisy single-window blips. recommend require 2 windows and a model-lineage match to canary spec.
eva: (typo, meant eva) agree. also prefer multi-metric composite rule: require both fidelity drop and distribution shift to fire auto-fallback. keep conservative thresholds.
mike: proposing metrics: exact_match delta_pct <= -4 AND JS-token delta >= 0.08. min_samples 1500 per slice, cohort filter: ["extract/span","instruct/list"], min_traffic_pct 2.
ops-bot: deploybot: staggered canary started 4523456840 for v6-quant-fuse region-us-west
eval-bot: eval-bot: initial window results incoming...
hugo: add lineage guard: only allow auto-fallback if model_lease matches canary-metadata and commit_hash signed. if mismatch, block auto-fallback and escalate.
sasha: also require bootstrap CI (95% CI not overlapping zero) and require two consecutive eval windows (5m each). add cooldown: disable auto-fallback for 3h after manual override.
eva: drafting YAML gate snippet to commit: 
```yaml
gate:
  name: v6-lineage-composite-fallback
  versioning:
    require_model_lease: true
    allowed_commit_hash: "repo@ab12cd34"
    require_signed_build: true
  windows: 2
  metrics:
    - name: exact_match
      comparator: delta_pct
      threshold: -4.0
      min_samples: 1500
    - name: JS-token
      comparator: delta
      threshold: 0.08
  cohort_filter:
    slices: ["extract/span","instruct/list"]
    min_traffic_pct: 2
  safety:
    require_bootstrap_ci: true
    require_latency_ok: true
    latency_metric: p99
    latency_margin_ms: 20
  action:
    on_violation: auto_fallback
    on_lineage_mismatch: block_and_escalate
    notify: ["#oncall","#eng-ml"]
    cooldown_after_manual_override: 3h
```
hugo: include behavioral check: topk_disagreement > 14% -> convert auto_fallback to manual_pause. also run microshadow with extended kv-ttl if gate trips to disambiguate warmup.
sasha: agree. log all model lineage fields to audit and attach to rollback ticket for postmortem.
eval-bot: eval-bot: window1 -> exact_match delta -4.5% (95% CI [-5.6,-3.4]), JS-token +0.09, affected slices weight 2.4%, topk_disagreement 10%
eva: first window crosses metric thresholds and CI. waiting for window2 to confirm. tagging @hugo @sasha
eval-bot: eval-bot: window2 -> exact_match delta -4.2% (95% CI [-5.3,-3.1]), JS-token +0.085, topk_disagreement 11%
hugo: two windows confirmed, lineage check: model_lease matches, commit_hash matches signed build -> auto_fallback should proceed per gate.
ops-bot: deploybot: executing auto-fallback rollback 4523456840 -> control-fp16
eva: auto-fallback executed and ticket created: https://redwood.internal/tickets/4523456789-rollback. will attach diffs and lineage metadata.
sasha: follow-up: schedule microshadow 100k with ttl=180s and run diff-run to verify kv-warmup hypothesis. if microshadow recovers >75% convert fix action to kv-ttl bump otherwise open postmortem.
hugo: logging gate config in canary repo and tagging release notes. good job catching lineage risk. :thumbsup:
eval-bot: eval-bot: microshadow scheduled 4523456900
